rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a protrusion or hook used to hang clothes and other items.

example.english: This coat can just hang on the peg behind the door.
example.traditional: 呢件外套掛喺門後面個掛鈎度就得喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 gwaa3 hai2 mun4 hau6 min6 go3 gwaa3 ngau1 dou6 zau6 dak1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the ordinary wooden version of a fastening peg.

example.english: This board is fastened with a wooden peg.
example.traditional: 呢塊木板係用一枝木釘固定嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 faai3 muk6 baan2 hai6 jung6 jat1 zi1 muk6 deng1 gu3 ding6 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the metal or mechanical pin used to fasten or bear between assembled parts, rather than an ordinary wooden peg.

example.english: The engineer checked it and said this peg needs replacing.
example.traditional: 工程師檢查過，呢條銷釘要換喇。
example.jyutping: gung1 cing4 si1 gim2 caa4 gwo3 ni1 tiu4 siu1 deng1 jiu3 wun6 laa3
